listing.name: Metal Slug X arcade / omegakatana92
listing.summary: Native static recompilation of Metal Slug X (SNK, 1999) for Windows x64 and Steam Deck. The 68000 program is translated to C and runs against a Neo Geo MVS board model - no emulator frontend - with Z80/YM2610 sound, real BIOS boot, SDL2 video and input, 90.04% native coverage and 0 verify mismatches. Bring your own ROMs.
